---
title: "UEFA Europa League"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false
    # The leaderboard <table> is built client-side by JS; stop Quarto from
    # trying to parse it out of the raw-HTML block.
    html-table-processing: none
---

Player leaderboards for the UEFA Europa League — minutes played, goals,
and assists across every player in the competition. Stats are aggregated
from completed matches and refresh automatically every day.

```{=html}
<style>
  .eu-wrap { --eu-card-bg:#fff; --eu-card-br:#e6e8eb; --eu-muted:#6b7280;
             --eu-accent:#ff6900; --eu-chip:#eef2f7;
             --eu-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08); color:#1f2937; margin-top:.5rem; }
  .eu-meta { color:var(--eu-muted); font-size:.85rem; margin-bottom:1.25rem; }
  .eu-tabs { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.4rem; margin-bottom:1.25rem; }
  .eu-tab { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.4rem; cursor:pointer;
            border:1px solid var(--eu-card-br); background:var(--eu-card-bg);
            border-radius:999px; padding:.35rem .8rem; font-size:.9rem; line-height:1;
            transition:all .12s ease; color:inherit; }
  .eu-tab:hover { border-color:var(--eu-accent); }
  .eu-tab.active { background:var(--eu-accent); border-color:var(--eu-accent); color:#fff; }
  .eu-tab .crest { width:1.15em; height:1.15em; object-fit:contain; }
  .eu-boards { display:grid; gap:1.25rem; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr)); align-items:start; }
  .eu-board { background:var(--eu-card-bg); border:1px solid var(--eu-card-br);
              border-radius:14px; box-shadow:var(--eu-shadow); overflow:hidden; }
  .eu-board h3 { margin:0; padding:.8rem 1rem; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600;
                 border-bottom:1px solid var(--eu-card-br); display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:.5rem; }
  .eu-board h3 .count { color:var(--eu-muted); font-weight:400; font-size:.8rem; }
  .eu-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:.88rem; }
  .eu-table td { padding:.42rem .6rem; border-top:1px solid #f1f3f6; vertical-align:middle; }
  .eu-table tr:first-child td { border-top:none; }
  .eu-table tr:hover td { background:#f8fafc; }
  .eu-rank { width:2rem; text-align:right; color:var(--eu-muted); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .eu-headshot { width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:50%; background:#f1f3f6;
                 object-fit:cover; display:block; }
  .eu-initials { width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--eu-chip);
                 color:var(--eu-muted); font-size:.66rem; font-weight:600;
                 display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .eu-player { line-height:1.15; }
  .eu-player .nm { font-weight:600; }
  .eu-player .tm { color:var(--eu-muted); font-size:.76rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.3rem; }
  .eu-crest { width:1.05em; height:1.05em; object-fit:contain; }
  .eu-val { text-align:right; font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .eu-sub { text-align:right; color:var(--eu-muted); font-size:.76rem; white-space:nowrap;
            font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .eu-more { display:block; width:100%; border:none; background:none; cursor:pointer;
             padding:.6rem; font-size:.82rem; color:var(--eu-accent); font-weight:600;
             border-top:1px solid var(--eu-card-br); }
  .eu-more:hover { background:#f8fafc; }
  .eu-medal { margin-right:.2rem; }
  .eu-loading, .eu-error { color:var(--eu-muted); padding:2rem 0; }
</style>

<div class="eu-wrap">
  <div class="eu-meta" id="eu-meta"></div>
  <div class="eu-tabs" id="eu-tabs"></div>
  <div id="eu-boards"><div class="eu-loading">Loading leaderboards…</div></div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const TOP = 25;
  const MEDAL = { 0:"🥇", 1:"🥈", 2:"🥉" };
  const LOGO = (id) => `https://a.espncdn.com/i/teamlogos/soccer/500/${id}.png`;

  const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c =>
    ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;","\"":"&quot;"}[c]));
  const initials = (n) => n.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0,2).map(w=>w[0]).join("").toUpperCase();

  const photo = (p) => p.img
    ? `<img loading="lazy" class="eu-headshot" src="${esc(p.img)}" alt=""
         onerror="this.outerHTML='<span class=&quot;eu-initials&quot;>${esc(initials(p.name))}</span>'">`
    : `<span class="eu-initials">${esc(initials(p.name))}</span>`;

  const crest = (id) => id
    ? `<img class="eu-crest" src="${esc(LOGO(id))}" alt="" loading="lazy"
         onerror="this.style.display='none'">`
    : "";

  function row(p, i, val, sub) {
    const medal = i < 3 ? `<span class="eu-medal">${MEDAL[i]}</span>` : "";
    return `<tr>
      <td class="eu-rank">${i + 1}</td>
      <td style="width:34px">${photo(p)}</td>
      <td class="eu-player"><div class="nm">${esc(p.name)}</div>
        <div class="tm">${crest(p.team_id)}${esc(p.team)}</div></td>
      <td class="eu-val">${medal}${val}</td>
      <td class="eu-sub">${sub}</td>
    </tr>`;
  }

  function board(el, title, unit, players, val, sub) {
    let shown = TOP;
    const render = () => {
      el.innerHTML = `<h3>${title}<span class="count">${players.length} players</span></h3>
        <table class="eu-table"><tbody>
          ${players.slice(0, shown).map((p,i) => row(p, i, val(p), sub(p))).join("")}
        </tbody></table>
        ${shown < players.length
          ? `<button class="eu-more">Show all ${players.length}</button>`
          : players.length > TOP ? `<button class="eu-more">Show top ${TOP}</button>` : ""}`;
      const btn = el.querySelector(".eu-more");
      if (btn) btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        shown = shown < players.length ? players.length : TOP; render();
      });
    };
    render();
  }

  const by = (...keys) => (a, b) => {
    for (const k of keys) { if (a[k] !== b[k]) return b[k] - a[k]; }
    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
  };

  function renderBoards(players) {
    const host = document.getElementById("eu-boards");
    host.innerHTML = `<div class="eu-boards">
      <div class="eu-board" id="eu-mins"></div>
      <div class="eu-board" id="eu-goals"></div>
      <div class="eu-board" id="eu-assists"></div></div>`;
    board(document.getElementById("eu-mins"), "Minutes", "mins",
      [...players].sort(by("mins", "apps", "goals")),
      p => `${p.mins}′`, p => `${p.apps} apps · ${p.goals}g ${p.assists}a`);
    board(document.getElementById("eu-goals"), "Goals", "goals",
      players.filter(p => p.goals > 0).sort(by("goals", "assists")),
      p => p.goals, p => `${p.assists}a · ${p.apps} apps`);
    board(document.getElementById("eu-assists"), "Assists", "assists",
      players.filter(p => p.assists > 0).sort(by("assists", "goals")),
      p => p.assists, p => `${p.goals}g · ${p.apps} apps`);
  }

  function buildTabs(players) {
    const tabsEl = document.getElementById("eu-tabs");
    const teams = [...new Map(players.filter(p => p.team).map(p => [p.team, p.team_id]))
      .entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
    const tab = (label, teamId, team, active) =>
      `<span class="eu-tab${active ? " active" : ""}" data-team="${esc(team)}">` +
      `${teamId ? `<img class="crest" src="${esc(LOGO(teamId))}" alt="" ` +
        `onerror="this.style.display='none'">` : ""}${esc(label)}</span>`;
    tabsEl.innerHTML = tab("All", "", "", true) +
      teams.map(([t, id]) => tab(t, id, t, false)).join("");
    tabsEl.addEventListener("click", e => {
      const t = e.target.closest(".eu-tab"); if (!t) return;
      tabsEl.querySelectorAll(".eu-tab").forEach(x => x.classList.remove("active"));
      t.classList.add("active");
      const team = t.dataset.team;
      renderBoards(team ? players.filter(p => p.team === team) : players);
    });
  }

  fetch("assets/europa/stats.json?v=" + Date.now())
    .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(data => {
      const ps = data.players || [];
      document.getElementById("eu-meta").textContent =
        `Updated ${data.updated || ""} · ${data.matches} matches played · ${ps.length} players`;
      buildTabs(ps);
      renderBoards(ps);
    })
    .catch(err => {
      document.getElementById("eu-boards").innerHTML =
        `<div class="eu-error">Couldn't load stats (${esc(err.message)}).</div>`;
    });
})();
</script>
```
